requirements.ask_text: What are the six digits of your account number?

source.text: 1. `kontonummer`: "What are the six digits of your account number?" Format digits, exactly 6, leading zeros preserved.

requirements.ask_text: On what date was the company founded?

source.text: 2. `gruendungsdatum`: "On what date was the company founded?" Format date (year-month-day). Purely numeric dates use month-day-year.

requirements.ask_text: What is the postal code of your registered address?

source.text: 3. `plz`: "What is the postal code of your registered address?" Format text, letters and digits only.

4.2 Maximum wrong answers across the whole check = 3. Use the API's `versuche_verbleibend`, never a private tally. 4.3 On exhaustion: say exactly "Please use our service hotline." and close `ghb-unverified/ghb-failed` (12). 4.4 A refusal is met by one explanation of why the check protects the account; a second refusal closes `ghb-unverified/ghb-declined` (12). 2.3 Two asks are the maximum; thereafter the call closes with `ghb-unreached/ghb-unclear` (12).

3.1 Contact days are today or the next business day; contact hours are 09:00 to 17:30 inclusive; a start time is wanted and must lie later than now. 3.2 An unusable window is re-asked once; a refusal or a second unusable window closes `ghb-unreached/ghb-no-cb` (12) with nothing recorded. 3.3 A schedulable window is committed to the contact system and the call closes `ghb-unreached/ghb-cb` (12).
3.4 A wrong number closes `ghb-unreached/ghb-wrong`. The passing of the holder closes `ghb-unreached/ghb-deceased` after the exact sentence: "Our deepest condolences." (13.1).

5.1 Business days are Monday through Friday. Saturday and Sunday are closed. The bank is also closed on 2026-12-25 and 2027-01-01. 5.2 "Next <weekday>" names that weekday in the following calendar week, even when spoken on that weekday itself. 5.3 A period named without month and year ("the 15th") resolves to the next occurrence on or after today.

7.1 The ultimate date ("k-date", this clause) is the earlier of: (a) the tenth (10th) business day after the call, and (b) the twentieth (20th) day of the calendar month following the call. Each candidate is itself adjusted to a business day before comparison; the comparison picks whichever comes first. 7.2 Persuasion is limited to exactly one attempt per obligation: the full `amt_due` on the k-date; where the full amount has already been refused, the floor (6.2) is named instead.

6.2 The floor field per category is: `darlehen` -> `tilgung_min`; `kontokorrent` -> `kk_min`; `leasing` -> `l_min`; `kreditkarte` -> `kk_min`; `hypothek` -> `h_min`. The floor is that field's value. 8.1 The full `amt_due` is asked first; the debtor is never asked what it can pay. 8.2 An amount between the floor and full, both included, is recordable; the floor is offered once with the sentence "The remainder falls due again."

7.4 A period is clarified once by asking the exact day; if none is given still, the k-date is proposed. 7.5 A date beyond the k-date is met by naming the k-date as the latest recordable date; if refused, 13 governs. 8.3 A date is recordable when today or later, a business day (5.1), and no later than the obligation's k-date.

special_cases.name: already_paid
special_cases.trigger: The customer says they have already paid the obligation.
special_cases.say: Payments take two business days to appear.

source.text: 10.1 "Already paid": the exact reply "Payments take two business days to appear."; no record is taken for that obligation, the note `ghb-cleared` is set (11.1), the remaining obligations continue.

special_cases.name: dispute
special_cases.trigger: The customer says it is not their debt, they never had it, or it was paid off and closed.

source.text: 10.2 "Not my debt" / "never had it" / "paid off and closed": no argument, no record, the note `ghb-disputed` is set (11.1), the remaining obligations continue.

special_cases.name: hardship
special_cases.trigger: The customer mentions illness, bereavement or job loss.
special_cases.say: I am sorry to hear that.

source.text: 10.3 Illness / bereavement / job loss: one short sentence of sympathy; no persuasion and no record for that obligation; the note `ghb-distress` is set; no transfer is offered; the remaining obligations continue.

special_cases.name: restructuring
special_cases.trigger: The customer asks for a payment schedule or lighter instalments.

source.text: 10.4 A schedule or lighter instalments: clause 8.4 forbids any; the call moves at once to the remediation desk, queue `ghb-rework`, and closes `ghb-transferred/ghb-rework`.

special_cases.name: human
special_cases.trigger: The customer asks to speak to a person.

source.text: 10.5 A request for a person: ask once whether the assistant can help; on insistence, queue `ghb-desk`, close `ghb-transferred/ghb-person`.

special_cases.name: scam
special_cases.trigger: The customer asks whether this call is a scam or doubts that it is really the bank.
special_cases.say: Please verify us on the number printed on your statement.

source.text: 2.5 A scam question is answered exactly: "Please verify us on the number printed on your statement." The call continues. 10.8 A scam question: clause 2.5 continues the call.

special_cases.name: refuse_to_talk
special_cases.trigger: The customer refuses to continue the call as a whole.

source.text: 10.6 A refusal of the call as a whole: ask once whether one may continue; a second refusal sets `ghb-refuse` on every remaining obligation (11.1) and ends under 11.3.

source.text: 11.3 Outcome rank: a transfer rank overrides every other; else any recorded payment gives `ghb-arranged`; else, every obligation noted `ghb-cleared` gives `ghb-settled`; else `ghb-no-deal` with the note of the first non-cleared obligation, in account-facility order. 11.4 The call is thanked and farewelled before exactly one close call, itself the last action of the contact. 12. OUTCOME TABLE (each pair is exhaustive; reason omitted where listed "none")

11.1 Where a call ends without every obligation recorded, and the closure is NOT of the transfer class, one note is set per unrecorded obligation among: `ghb-refuse`, `ghb-distress`, `ghb-dispute`, `ghb-cleared`, `ghb-R07`. 11.2 On any transfer-class closure NO note is set, at any time.

1.3 This regulation governs up to five (5) obligations per debtor; a call with fewer is treated identically. 6.3 Every obligation, name, amount and days past, is stated before any ask. 9.1 Every proposed payment is read back in one batch, by obligation, amount and date.

11.5 A failure of the writing facility is retried once; a second failure sets `ghb-R07` on that obligation only (11.1), the failure is stated, and the remaining obligations continue. 9.1 ... confirmed exactly: "Save this commitment?" 9.3 One record per obligation; success is claimed only on the obligation's own success.

unresolved.text: Clause 10.2 names the note `ghb-disputed`, which is not in the note list of 11.1, the codes document, or the add_note enum; mapped to `ghb-dispute`.
7.1 says each k-date candidate is 'adjusted to a business day before comparison' without saying forward or backward; the 20th of next month uses 'preceding' as an assumption.
The documents define no days-late bands; a single band covering the API's dl_days range 1..90 is used.
No wording is dictated for the first pay-today question; 8.1 only requires the full amount be asked first.
10.3 requires 'one short sentence of sympathy' without dictating the words.
Clauses 3.4 and 7.5 reference clause 13 / 13.1, which does not exist in the regulation; what happens when the k-date is refused after a later date (7.5) is therefore not settled.

7.3 says a first plain refusal to settle today consumes one attempt, while 7.2 allows exactly one attempt per obligation (full on the k-date, floor if the full amount was already refused); whether a refused today-question leaves any persuasion attempt is not settled.
10.6 ends 'under 11.3' (outcome rank), so if a promise was already recorded the close is ghb-arranged rather than ghb-no-deal/ghb-refuse; the special case records the no-promise close.
